markets.name: Auchan
markets.note: anchor; recon 2026-07-02: plain requests GET https://zakupy.auchan.pl/ = 200 (real SPA shell, no CDN/WAF block). Driving that shell's own homepage load — even via plain requests, no Playwright required — hits the unauthenticated GET https://zakupy.auchan.pl/api/webproductpagews/v5/product-pages?decoratedOnly=true&limit=N&tag=web&tag=lohp endpoint, which returns real curated 'featured'/'on_offer'/'group' product listings (name/brand/price/promoPrice/packSizeDescription/catchweight/categoryPath/image) — genuine live data, not a full category crawl (the SPA's per-category /api/webproductpagews/v6/products endpoint requires a CSRF token + session-bound client-route-id minted by the SPA, out of scope for the recon budget). Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/auchan_pl_sample.json).

markets.name: Biedronka
markets.note: discounter; recon 2026-07-02: the corporate/leaflet site www.biedronka.pl/pl is gazetka-only (no catalog), BUT Biedronka also runs a genuine e-commerce storefront at https://zakupy.biedronka.pl/ (Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Demandware) — plain `requests` GET of both the homepage and category pages (e.g. /nabial/mleko/) = 200, real server-rendered product tiles, no Cloudflare/WAF, no Playwright needed. Each tile embeds a `data-product-gtm="{...}"` JSON attribute (GA4 ecommerce tracking) with clean name/id/price/brand/category fields — cleaner than parsing the visual price markup. No EAN/GTIN present anywhere (checked tile markup + a live PDP fetch) -> barcode left None. Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/biedronka_sample.html, /nabial/mleko/, 10 real dairy products, 0 barcodes).

markets.name: Lidl
markets.note: discounter; recon 2026-07-02: www.lidl.pl/ and its CMS category hub pages (e.g. /c/zywnosc-i-napoje/s10068374) are Nuxt-SSR content/teaser pages with no product grid (confirmed via Playwright too — no product/price XHR fired). BUT https://www.lidl.pl/q/search?q=<term> IS server-rendered with a genuine embedded Nuxt `__NUXT_DATA__` payload containing real current leaflet/shelf prices (title/brand/price/oldPrice/packaging/category/image), reachable via plain `requests`, no Playwright needed. EAN/GTIN exists in this payload ONLY on Lidl's general/durable-goods (NonFood) items, never on Food items -> barcode left None for groceries. Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/lidl_pl_sample.json, /q/search?q=mleko, 11 real products across Food+NonFood, 0 barcodes).

markets.name: Żabka
markets.note: convenience; recon 2026-07-02: the delivery app site https://jush.pl/ is a plain WordPress marketing landing page for the mobile app (no __NEXT_DATA__/__NUXT__/inline bundle at all) with no reachable catalog (jush.pl/sklep, app.jush.pl, sklep.jush.pl, api.jush.pl all 404/unreachable) — the real Jush delivery catalog is app-only. BUT https://www.zabka.pl/ (also 200, plain requests, no Playwright) embeds a real 'this week's offers' Gutenberg product carousel directly on the homepage with genuine names/package sizes and (for ~half the tiles) an explicit current zł price via the EU Omnibus 'lowest price in 30 days' label. Curated, not a full catalog (~16 tiles, no pagination/search endpoint found); no EAN or separate brand field -> both left None. Real fixture captured (see countries/poland/fixtures/zabka_sample.html, 8 real products with unambiguous single-value prices, 0 barcodes).
